BAAssetPack.doc: An archive of assets that the system downloads together.

BAAssetPackManager.doc: A class that manages asset packs.

BAAssetPackManifest.doc: A manifest of asset packs that are available to download.

BADownload.doc: An object that represents an in-progress or concluded asset download.

BADownloadManager.doc: An object that manages the queue of scheduled asset downloads.

BAURLDownload.doc: An object that represents a remote asset to download.

BADownloadManagerDelegate.doc: An interface for reacting to asset download events and processing concluded downloads.

BADownloaderExtension.doc: An interface for reacting to app life-cycle events and processing concluded asset downloads while your app isn’t running.

BAManagedAssetPackDownloadDelegate.doc: An object that handles status updates when downloading an asset pack.

BAManagedDownloaderExtension.doc: An application extension that uses the system implementation to schedule asset-pack downloads automatically.

BAAssetPackStatus.doc: The status of an asset pack.

BAAssetPackStatusDownloadAvailable.doc: A status value that indicates that the asset pack is available to download.

BAAssetPackStatusDownloaded.doc: A status value that indicates that the system finished downloading the asset pack.

BAAssetPackStatusDownloading.doc: A status value that indicates that the system is currently downloading the asset pack.

BAAssetPackStatusObsolete.doc: A status value that indicates that the asset pack is no longer available to download.

BAAssetPackStatusOutOfDate.doc: A status value that indicates that the downloaded asset pack is out of date.

BAAssetPackStatusUpToDate.doc: A status value that indicates that the downloaded asset pack is up to date.

BAAssetPackStatusUpdateAvailable.doc: A status value that indicates that an update to the asset pack is available to download.

BAContentRequest.doc: The content request type used in the downloader extension.

BAContentRequestInstall.doc: A content request resulting from the installation of the app.

BAContentRequestLanguageChange.doc: A content request resulting from someone changing the app’s preferred language.

BAContentRequestPeriodic.doc: A content request resulting from a system request for updated content within the app.

BAContentRequestUpdate.doc: A content request resulting from an update of the app.

BADownloadState.doc: Constants that indicate the state of a download.

BAManagedErrorCode.doc: An error code for a managed asset pack.

BAManagedErrorCodeAssetPackNotFound.doc: An error code that indicates the system couldn’t find an asset pack with the given identifier.

BAManagedErrorCodeFileNotFound.doc: An error code that indicates the system couldn’t find a file at the specified path.

BAManagedErrorCodeLocalAvailabilityFailu.doc: An error code that indicates that the system couldn’t ensure the local availability of some or all of the requested asset packs.

-download.doc: Creates a download object for the asset pack that you schedule using a download manager.

-downloadForContentRequest:.doc: Creates a download object for the asset pack that you schedule using a download manager.

-URLForPath:asLocalizedForLanguage:error.doc: Returns a URL for the specified relative path.

-URLForPath:error:.doc: Returns a URL for the specified relative path.

-assetPackIsAvailableLocallyWithIdentifi.doc: Checks whether the asset pack with the specified identifier is available locally.

-checkForUpdatesWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Gets the latest asset-pack information from the server, updates outdated asset packs, and removes obsolete asset packs.

-contentsAtPath:asLocalizedForLanguage:o.doc: Returns the contents of a localized asset file at the specified relative path.

-contentsAtPath:searchingInAssetPackWith.doc: Returns the contents of an asset file at the specified relative path.

-ensureLocalAvailabilityOfAssetPack:comp.doc: Ensures that the specified asset pack be available locally.

-ensureLocalAvailabilityOfAssetPack:requ.doc: Ensures that the specified asset pack is available locally, performing a download if necessary.

-ensureLocalAvailabilityOfAssetPacks:com.doc: Ensures that the specified asset packs are available locally.

-ensureLocalAvailabilityOfAssetPacks:req.doc: Ensures that the specified asset packs are available locally, performing a batch download if necessary.

-fileDescriptorForPath:asLocalizedForLan.doc: Opens and returns a file descriptor for a localized asset file at the specified relative path.

-fileDescriptorForPath:searchingInAssetP.doc: Opens and returns a file descriptor for the asset file at the specified relative path.

-getAllAssetPacksWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Gets the asset packs that are available to download.

-getAssetPackWithIdentifier:completionHa.doc: Gets the asset pack with the given identifier.

-getLocalStatusOfAssetPackWithIdentifier.doc: Gets an asset pack’s local status.

-getLocallyAvailableLanguagesWithComplet.doc: Gets the languages used by asset packs that are localized and are available locally.

-getManifestWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Gets the manifest of asset packs that are available to download.

-getStatusRelativeToAssetPack:completion.doc: Gets the current status relative to a particular asset pack.

-reconcilePreferredLanguagesWithCompleti.doc: Reconciles the set of locally available asset packs with the current preferred languages.

-removeAssetPackWithIdentifier:completio.doc: Removes the specified asset pack from the device.

-allDownloads.doc: Creates download objects for every asset pack in this manifest.

-allDownloadsForContentRequest:.doc: Creates download objects for every asset pack in this manifest.

-assetPackWithIdentifier:.doc: Returns the asset pack in this manifest with the given identifier.

-initFromData:applicationGroupIdentifier.doc: Initializes a representation of a manifest in memory from JSON-encoded data.

-initWithContentsOfURL:applicationGroupI.doc: Initializes a representation of a manifest in memory given a URL to the manifest’s representation as a JSON file on disk.

-localizedAssetPacksForLanguage:.doc: Returns the subset of asset packs in this manifest that are available to download and that best match the specified language.

-fetchCurrentDownloadsWithCompletionHand.doc: Fetches the contents of the manager’s download queue.

-performWithExclusiveControl:.doc: Attempts to acquire immediate, exclusive access to the download manager.

-scheduleDownload:error:.doc: Schedules an asset download to execute in the background at a nonspecific time in the future.

-startForegroundDownload:error:.doc: Schedules an asset download that executes immediately in the foreground.

downloadSize.doc: The size of the download file containing the asset pack in bytes.

identifier.doc: A unique identifier for the asset pack.

language.doc: The language, represented as a BCP-47 identifier, for which this asset pack is localized.

userInfo.doc: JSON-encoded custom information that’s associated with the asset pack.

delegate.doc: An object that receives notifications about events that occur as an asset pack is downloaded.

resolvedLanguage.doc: The language asset packs that are localized for which the system automatically makes available locally, represented as a BCP-47 identifier.

assetPacks.doc: The asset packs in this manifest that are available to download.

availableLanguages.doc: The languages, represented as their respective BCP-47 identifiers, for which asset packs in this manifest are localized.

localizedAssetPacks.doc: The subset of asset packs in this manifest that best match the current preferred languages.

primaryLanguage.doc: The application’s primary language, represented as a BCP-47 identifier, as configured in App Store Connect.

resolvedLanguage.doc: The language, represented as a BCP-47 identifier, asset packs in this manifest that are localized for which the system automatically makes available locally.

BADownloadState.doc: Constants that indicate the state of a download.

BADownloaderPriority.doc: A type that determines the execution priority of a scheduled asset download.

identifier.doc: The app-specific string that uniquely identifies the downloadable asset.

state.doc: The current state of the download.

uniqueIdentifier.doc: The system-provided string that uniquely identifies the download object.

sharedManager.doc: The download manager that both the app and the extension share.
